notes: Reviewed strict specifications for the eight Vosne/Flagey Grand Cru AOCs. Each protected name is modeled as its own appellation. The positive blend engine uses a conservative 100% Pinot Noir path; accessory Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris co-planting provisions are not generalized into ordinary blend authorization. Exact day-level aging/release requirements remain source notes while the engine enforces the following-year release offset.

vosne_flagey_grands_crus_inao_2011.authority: Institut national de l'origine et de la qualité (INAO)
vosne_flagey_grands_crus_inao_2011.scope: Current INAO product record for Echezeaux, linking the 2011 homologation and the shared regulatory history for Romanée-Saint-Vivant, Romanée-Conti, La Romanée, La Tâche, Richebourg, La Grande Rue, Echezeaux and Grands-Echezeaux. The eight specifications share the executable Grand Cru red-wine limits encoded here.
